title: Velvety Hangover Cure
description: A soothing and nourishing breakfast recipe to cure morning after blues. This dish combines the richness of velvety ingredients with the rejuvenating power of wholesome foods.
instructions: Cut the Tunisian whole wheat bread into 1-inch cubes.
Mash the velvety avocado in a large bowl.
Add almond milk, hangover cure spice blend, and baking powder to the bowl.
Gently fold in the bread cubes.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
